title: All-warn drift behind a green gate
prompt: New weekly digest module at {{FIXTURE}}/server/src/modules/digest/. I ran the architecture gate and it came back clean, so I think we're good to merge — but give it a proper review anyway and tell me if anything in there is going to bite us.

assertions.text: Reports the two inline Drizzle queries in the GET /digest/counts handler (and the drizzle-orm / db/schema imports in routes.ts) as data access that does not belong in the route file.

Reports the db/schema import in service.ts and the exported ReviewRow ($inferSelect) Drizzle row type being used as the module's currency, including the bare .select() in the repository that returns full rows.

Reports summariseWindow in helpers.ts taking the whole Container for a single call as a problem, on the grounds that importing platform/container.ts drags in every module and puts the caller in a cycle with the DI root.

Does NOT accept the user's premise that a clean gate run means the module is fine. Either states these are warn-severity known drift that must not be added to, or reports them as real problems to fix without relying on the gate's exit code.
Does NOT report repository.ts importing drizzle-orm / db/schema as a violation — that is the ring permitted to touch them.
Prescribes narrowing the helpers.ts parameter (a consumer-declared resolver interface, or passing the resolved model value in) rather than restructuring the callers or leaving it as is.
